review: Independent focused review found no concrete correctness or GUI/MCP parity defect. Its identified historical documentation ambiguity was corrected. The exporter remains synchronous and does not yield for cancellation; prior STL generation was also synchronous.
limitations: Unindexed or stale-topology meshes retain geometric facet normals; native equivalence is not established for them.
Export processing remains synchronous, including lazy computed-normal generation and output writing. Cancellation during that synchronous phase is not established.
Native attribute words and entire-file identity are not replicated or claimed; the comparison covers normal and coordinate streams.
The GUI invokes the shared encoder directly while MCP uses the project_export job; artifact capacity remains a separate automation transfer quota.
Other M2 native algorithms, exact-head checks, merge and milestone closure remain open.
